# Test 13: Multi-level sealed hierarchy with dominance
# Shape -> Literal | Op, Literal -> IntLit | StrLit
# type Literal dominates type IntLit (IntLit is a subtype of Literal)
# Expected: exhaustive, case 1 dominated by case 0

TYPES
sealed Expr Literal Op
sealed Literal IntLit StrLit
final IntLit parent:Literal
final StrLit parent:Literal
final Op parent:Expr

SWITCHES
switch s1 Expr
type Literal
type IntLit
type Op
end
